clauses.title: POSITION AND OPERATIONAL DUTIES
clauses.verbatim_text: Executive shall serve as Chief Technology Officer reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and the Board of Directors, rendering full-time professional services in biometric cryptography.
obligations: Executive must serve full-time as Chief Technology Officer in biometric cryptography
Executive must report directly to CEO and Board of Directors
rights: Company receives full-time executive services and reporting
material_claims: Executive serves as Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
Executive reports directly to CEO and Board of Directors
Executive renders full-time professional services in biometric cryptography

clauses.title: COMPENSATION AND PERFORMANCE BONUS
clauses.verbatim_text: Company shall pay Executive an annual base salary of two hundred forty thousand dollars ($240,000), payable in semi-monthly installments. Executive is eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus of up to thirty percent (30%) of base salary upon meeting corporate milestones.
obligations: Company must pay base salary of $240,000 per year in semi-monthly installments
rights: Executive is eligible for up to 30% discretionary performance bonus based on meeting corporate milestones
conditions: Bonus is contingent on meeting corporate milestones and remains discretionary
material_claims: Annual base salary is $240,000 payable semi-monthly
Discretionary performance bonus up to 30% of base salary upon meeting corporate milestones

clauses.title: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY ASSIGNMENT
clauses.verbatim_text: All inventions, cryptographic algorithms, source code, and patentable discoveries conceived, developed, or reduced to practice by Executive during the term of employment shall belong exclusively to Company as works made for hire.
obligations: Executive assigns all inventions, algorithms, code, and discoveries to Company as works made for hire
rights: Company owns exclusive rights to all IP conceived/developed during employment
conditions: Applies to IP conceived, developed, or reduced to practice during employment term
material_claims: All inventions, algorithms, source code, and patentable discoveries belong exclusively to Company
Assigned as works made for hire during employment term

clauses.title: POST-EMPLOYMENT NON-COMPETE COVENANT
clauses.verbatim_text: During employment and for eighteen (18) months following termination, Executive shall not directly or indirectly engage in, advise, or invest in any competing biometric identity verification business anywhere in North America.
obligations: Executive must not engage in, advise, or invest in competing biometric identity verification business in North America for 18 months post-termination
rights: Company is protected from post-employment competition by Executive
conditions: Restriction applies during employment and for 18 months after termination across North America
material_claims: Non-compete covenant lasts during employment plus 18 months post-termination
Covers competing biometric identity verification businesses

clauses.title: TERMINATION AND SEVERANCE ENTITLEMENT
clauses.verbatim_text: Either party may terminate employment without cause upon thirty (30) days written notice. If Company terminates Executive without Cause, Executive shall receive six (6) months of base salary continuation as severance, conditioned upon Executive executing an effective general release of claims.
obligations: Terminating party must provide 30 days written notice for termination without cause
Company must pay 6 months base salary continuation if terminating without cause
Executive must execute an effective general release of claims to receive severance
rights: Either party has right to terminate without cause on 30 days notice
Executive has right to 6 months severance if terminated without cause
conditions: Severance payout is strictly conditioned upon Executive signing an effective general release of claims
exceptions: Severance only paid if Company terminates without Cause; not paid on voluntary resignation or termination for cause
material_claims: Termination without cause requires 30 days written notice by either party
Termination by Company without Cause entitles Executive to 6 months base salary severance continuation
Severance is conditioned on signing an effective general release of claims

clauses.title: GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
clauses.verbatim_text: This Agreement shall be construed and governed in accordance with the substantive laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The state courts located in Suffolk County, Massachusetts shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any controversy.
obligations: Litigate any controversy exclusively in Suffolk County, Massachusetts state courts
material_claims: Governed by substantive laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts
Exclusive jurisdiction in state courts of Suffolk County, Massachusetts
